text: The standard laboratory route is from alcohols, because it gives one clean product. Hydrochloric acid with zinc chloride, the Lucas reagent. Sodium bromide with sulphuric acid. Red phosphorus and iodine. Phosphorus pentachloride. And best of all, thionyl chloride, Darzen's process, because both by products are gases that simply escape.
